exposure: Term neonates with NEC vs. healthy term neonates
cohort: 14 term neonates (gestational age ≥37 weeks) with NEC and a control group of healthy term neonates
finding: Congenital heart disease (CHD) and maternal methamphetamine abuse were significantly associated with NEC in term neonates.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not found to be a significant risk factor for NEC in term neonates.
